_WARNING: VERIFY CURRENT PRICES BEFORE USE. These numbers drive cost estimates and cost caps only; they are not fetched from any provider and may be out of date. Check the provider's pricing page and edit this file (or pass --agent-opt prices_path=FILE) before relying on --max-cost-usd.
source: Anthropic first-party API list prices as cached in the claude-api reference on 2026-10-06 (https://www.anthropic.com/pricing). cache_write is the 5-minute-TTL prompt-cache write price (1.25x input); cache_read is the cache-hit price.

long_context._note: prompts above 100K tokens; cache prices derived as 1.25x / 0.1x of input

default._note: unknown Anthropic model: priced conservatively at the most expensive listed tier; add the model above

(loopback)._note: unlisted models on a loopback host only (localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1): local servers such as Ollama, vLLM or LM Studio have no per-token price

openai-compatible._note: default null = UNKNOWN price (not free): an unlisted model on any other host is refused when a cost cap is set or the host is not loopback, unless --agent-opt price_free=true. Add hosted models by name, e.g. "gpt-x": {"input": 1.0, "output": 4.0}

mock-model._note: FICTIONAL prices used only by MockLLMAgent in offline tests
